title: Lezyne’s first electric pump sets a new standard for sustainability
content:
Cyclist
Lezyne’s first electric pump sets a new standard for sustainability

Electric mini-pumps currently sit alongside extra-wide tyres, carbon spokes, low-stack pedal systems, AI training apps and PFAS-free jackets as the product categories attracting almost the full attention of the cycling industry at the moment. However, Lezyne’s new E-Drive electric pump might just put the full stop on that conversation as the new class leader.

The tech

Designed in-house by Lezyne’s expert engineers and manufactured in the brand’s own factory in Taiwan, the E-Drive is Lezyne’s first portable electric pump and has been through a long process of prototyping and testing to ensure it provides best-in-class inflation power, reliability and durability.

‘After testing all of the current e-pumps on the market, we knew our engineering team could build a better, more sustainable electric pump,’ says Lezyne’s vice president of engineering, Terry Cooke. ‘With our new E-Drive you’re getting superior quality, safer operation, and a longer-lasting, high-performance e-pump.’

So, what has Lezyne done to make the E-Drive stand out?

Cooling system

Lezyne says the key to the pump’s performance is its ‘advanced thermal management system’, which includes an internal fan alongside a CNC-machined aluminium heatsink extrusion, plus specialised low-friction tech. This system is the product of several years of refinement through the company’s LED development and it both eliminates the need for additional covers and keeps the pressure sensor safe, thus improving accuracy and long-term reliability.

Valve compatibility

The flexible hose on the E-Drive features Lezyne’s innovative Multi-Chuck, which is compatible with Presta and Schrader valves as well as the clever modern Clik valve standard.

Replaceable battery

The high-capacity 750mAh battery means the E-Drive is able to fully inflate up to six tyres on each charge, most tyres are filled in less than 90 seconds for rapid pumping whether at home or on a ride, and there’s a set and forget function to save time choosing your desired pressure.

Arguably the best part, though, is that, unlike other electric mini-pumps, the battery is user-replaceable, so you can sub in a fresh cell to keep the pump going, indefinitely extending the E-Drive’s lifespan.

The specs

  • Dimensions: 82mm x 56mm x 38mm
  • Weight: 198g
  • Max pressure: 120psi, 8.25 bar
  • Battery: 750 mAH
  • Capacity: Up to 6 full inflations per charge
  • Charging: USB-C
  • Compatible valves: Presta, Schrader, Clik
  • Extras: Flexible hose with Multi-Chuck; set and forget function

Learn more at ride.lezyne.com
